Name: Tessera Deployment 06 - Optional GitOps Role Definition (core RG)
Description: Optional: only when enable_gitops_kv_secrets_role = true, so Terraform can create the '<cluster>-secrets-read-gitops' custom role scoped to the environment's Key Vault. Assign at the Tessera core resource group ONLY: role definitions whose assignable scopes are wider (such as the Tessera deployment roles themselves, scoped to the subscription) stay out of reach.
